tasks.prompt: Generate PROJECT_REQUIREMENTS.md for orchestrator dashboard monitoring system. Document current critical problems: 10+ workflows running simultaneously with all logs mixed in same directory making it impossible to monitor individual workflows. Define success criteria: monitor 10+ concurrent workflows with real-time tracking, workflow-specific log separation, progress tracking with ETAs, deliverable tracking with download links. Target output: docs/PROJECT_REQUIREMENTS.md

key_requirements: Progress tracking with ETAs and agent activity

tasks.prompt: Generate UI_SPECIFICATIONS.md with detailed interface mockups using ASCII art. Create mockups for: 1) Main dashboard grid showing 10+ concurrent workflows, 2) Workflow detail view with logs and progress, 3) Multi-workflow comparison interface. Include responsive design considerations, user interaction flows, and accessibility requirements. Target output: docs/UI_SPECIFICATIONS.md

Generate TECHNICAL_SPECIFICATIONS.md for dashboard implementation using FastAPI + WebSocket stack. Define architecture for real-time monitoring, performance targets for 10+ concurrent workflows, integration constraints with existing orchestrator system. Include database schema, caching strategy, WebSocket event handling, and scalability considerations. Target output: docs/TECHNICAL_SPECIFICATIONS.md

Generate API_SPECIFICATIONS.md with complete REST endpoints and WebSocket event definitions. Document data models, request/response schemas, authentication, error handling, and rate limiting. Include OpenAPI/Swagger compatibility. Focus on workflow monitoring, log streaming, progress tracking, and deliverable management APIs. Target output: docs/API_SPECIFICATIONS.md
